Done. Here's what was added:

**Priorities**
| Level | Response Target | Role Gate | Notifications | Auto-Escalate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| low | 24h | any | normal | no |
| normal | 8h | any | normal | no |
| high | 4h | any | immediate_email | no |
| critical | 1h | senior/admin | urgent_page | → escalated group |

**Permissions added**
- `set_priority` → agent, senior, admin (assignment routing for low/normal/high)
- `set_critical` → senior, admin (explicit gate for critical)

**Effects added**
- `create/notification/priority` — fires priority-mode notification on ticket creation (drives immediate_email for high, urgent_page for critical)
- `create/analytics/always` — SLA clock start on every new ticket
- `create/analytics/priority` — priority-specific SLA record on creation
